text: dsh-session-recovery 是面向 DSH 的会话与记忆恢复工具，提供磁盘扫描、恢复数据拆分、会话文件重建以及会话续接修复能力。它还向 DSH Web 命令界面注册 /session-repair，可检查当前或指定会话并生成修复文件。适合需要从原始磁盘找回 DSH 数据或修复损坏会话的用户。需要 Node.js 24 或更高版本，并由用户指定输入设备和输出目录。

dsh-session-recovery recovers DSH session and memory data from disk. It scans session frames, splits events, rebuilds session files, rescues SQLite memory records, and repairs sessions that fail to resume. A /session-repair command is available in the DSH web interface. Requires Node.js 24 or later.

dsh-session-recovery 的功能「扫描并提取会话帧」：读取指定设备中的 zstd 帧，识别并输出可解析的 DSH 事件，便于后续整理。
dsh-session-recovery 的功能「拆分恢复事件」：根据 turn 重置或给定时间边界，将混合事件流写成两个按会话划分的 JSONL 文件。
dsh-session-recovery 的功能「重建会话文件」：对事件按时间排序、重编号并修复引用，再生成带逐行 zstd 帧的 DSH 会话文件。
dsh-session-recovery 的功能「修复无法续接的会话」：通过 /session-repair 命令或 CLI 检查并修复会话事件，生成修复副本；命令支持 dry-run 和显式 apply。
dsh-session-recovery 的功能「恢复 SQLite 记忆库」：扫描指定设备上的 SQLite 文件头，识别含 memories 表的候选数据库并导出可恢复记录。

dsh-session-recovery README · dsh-session-recovery：**Recover deleted/corrupted DeepSeek Harness sessions & memory from raw disk** [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://nodejs.org) [](LICENSE) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) English · [中文](README.zh.md) --- > 🛟 After `rm -rf ~/.dsh` or file corruption, dsh conversation logs (`session.jsonl.zstd`) and memory (`memory.db`) can usually be recovered **straight from the raw block device** — this repo is a battle-tested manual plus the scripts that made it work.

dsh-session-recovery README · ✨ Features：| | |
|---|---|
| 🧠 **Memory recovery** | Locate `memory.db` by its `SQLite format 3` header, dump the window, rescue rows via SQLite's official `.recover` (skips corrupt pages, keeps readable data). |
| 💬 **Session recovery** | Scan disk for zstd frame magic `0xFD2FB528`, cluster frames by disk offset, split sessions at `turn` resets, rebuild official-format `session.jsonl.zstd`. |
| 🔧 **Automatic repair** | Renumber `seq` contiguously, deep-fix `sourceEventSeqs`/`messageSeqs`, normalize `surfaceOp` — the rebuilt log passes DSH's validation. |
| 🔁 **Resume repair** | Rebuilt sessions can fail at *resume* (`invalid persisted inbox splice`, `Messages with role 'tool' must be a response to tool_calls`) — `repair-session.js` (or the `/session-repair` web command) replays DSH's inbox/surface/wire rules and fixes the file. |
| 🛡️ **Safe by design** | Scripts only **read** the block device and write to a directory you choose; the original disk is never modified. |

dsh-session-recovery README · 📦 Install as a dsh plugin：> **Note**: primarily a recovery toolkit (scripts + manual); it also installs as a dsh plugin that adds the **`/session-repair` command to the web UI**.

From a directory containing this repo (local install, no publish needed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-recovery
systemctl restart dsh-web
```

Then type in **any** session in the web UI:

dsh-session-recovery README · 📦 Install as a dsh plugin：```
/session-repair --dry-run              # analyze the current session (writes nothing)
/session-repair <session-id-or-path>   # repair → writes .repaired + a backup
/session-repair --apply <id>           # also replace the original file
```

By default only a new `.repaired` file plus a backup are written; `--apply` overwrites the original (refused for the live session hosting the command — run it from another session). Restart `dsh-web` after applying.
dsh-session-recovery README · 📦 Install as a dsh plugin：Requires **Node 24+** (`node:sqlite`, `node:zlib`).

dsh-session-recovery README · 📖 Background：DeepSeek Harness stores its data under `~/.dsh`:

```
~/.dsh/
├── sessions/<workspace-encoded>/<session-id>/session.jsonl.zstd   # conversation log
├── memory/memory.db                                               # dsh-mneme memory
└── storages/workspace.json                                        # workspace registry

dsh-session-recovery README · 📖 Background：The session log is a **concatenated stream of zstd frames — one frame per JSONL line** ([source](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl)). That per-line framing is exactly what makes partial recovery possible: even if some frames are overwritten, the intact frames around them still decode independently.
